test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following was a defining feature of India's mixed economy model during the Five Year Plan period?

options.text: Coexistence of public sector with regulated private sector

solution:
The correct answer is __**Coexistence of public sector with regulated private sector**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• India adopted a **mixed economy model** post-independence, wherein both the public sector and the private sector were allowed to coexist and contribute to economic development under government regulation.
